description: Complete statements moved between existing source contexts.

cases.rationale: A complete call statement moves between functions.
A complete declaration moves between functions.

source.cpp: void source() { source_anchor(); int total = compute(); }

destination.cpp: void destination() { destination_anchor(); int total = compute(); }

cases.rationale: A complete conditional moves between methods.

SourceCase.java: class SourceCase { void value(boolean ready) { sourceAnchor(); if (ready) { process(); } } }
DestinationCase.java: class DestinationCase { void value(boolean ready) { destinationAnchor(); } }

SourceCase.java: class SourceCase { void value(boolean ready) { sourceAnchor(); } }
DestinationCase.java: class DestinationCase { void value(boolean ready) { destinationAnchor(); if (ready) { process(); } } }

cases.rationale: A complete invocation moves between methods.

SourceCase.cs: class SourceCase { void Value(Service service) { SourceAnchor(); service.Flush(); } }
DestinationCase.cs: class DestinationCase { void Value(Service service) { DestinationAnchor(); } }

SourceCase.cs: class SourceCase { void Value(Service service) { SourceAnchor(); } }
DestinationCase.cs: class DestinationCase { void Value(Service service) { DestinationAnchor(); service.Flush(); } }
